system.description:
You conjure an impossible strong weapon made of the purest alloy.

Choose yourself or a creature within 10 spaces.

Until the end of their next turn, they gain one of the following weapons of your choice.

  • Bound Great Sword

    • Melee, 5 + ES Damage, Slashing, Two-Handed, Vicious, Magical, Cleave

  • Bound Great Hammer

    • Melee, 5 + ES Damage, Crushing, Push, Two-Handed, Magical, Rend

  • Bound Glaive

    • Melee, 4 + ES Damage, Slashing, Cleave, Range 2, Two-Handed, Magical, Penetrating

When the spell ends, the weapon disappears.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 rounds.

The spell ends immediately if the creature is killed, knocked unconscious, or otherwise disarmed of the weapon.
